short: I think someone is spying on me
title: I think someone is spying on my phone: what you can do now
pageTitle: I think someone is spying on my phone: what you can do now | Spamlock
description: Your phone or accounts seem watched? Steps you can take now: check who has access, look for unknown profiles and devices, and get expert help.
answer: Check who has access to your phone and accounts, and who can see your location. If you feel at risk, free expert help is available.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take if you think someone is spying on you

steps.title: Check who has access
steps.text: iPhone: Settings → Privacy & Security → Safety Check. Android: Settings → Security & privacy. You’ll see who you share with and which devices can get in, and you can stop it there.

steps.title: Look for unknown management profiles
steps.text: iPhone: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management. Remove any you don’t know.

steps.title: Check devices signed in to your account
steps.text: In your Apple or Google account. Remove any you don’t recognise.

steps.title: Check who can see your location
steps.text: Look in Find My and Google Maps location sharing, and stop sharing with anyone you don’t expect.

steps.title: Change your Apple or Google password
Update the phone
steps.text: In Settings, look for Software Update. Updates can remove spying tools that use old security holes.

steps.title: Get expert help if you feel at risk
steps.text: Free support for stalkerware, and Apple’s Lockdown Mode for people targeted because of their work.

app.title: This guide is in the Spamlock app
app.text: Mark each step as done as you go.
